preservationRules: Do not rename registry paths, resource namespaces, NBT keys, SavedData names, packet meanings, recipe IDs, tag IDs, or block-entity serialization without an explicit migration record.
The modern port must keep optional integrations isolated from core startup.
A passing compilation is not evidence of GUI, packet, model, world, or gameplay parity.
Old-world migration is unclaimed until it passes against backed-up fixtures.
knownScopeGaps: Detailed registry, NBT, SavedData, packet, recipe, and resource manifests are generated incrementally and remain release gates.
BuildCraft Compat is a separate optional-integration workstream.
